title: Police say Boston gang leader Mathias Saintil 'neutralised' in Cité Soleil operation
detail: Haiti's National Police announced that Mathias Saintil, alleged leader of the Boston gang in Cité Soleil, was shot in a police operation and died later in hospital, per a police source. Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé celebrated: 'One less gang leader.' Separately, police reported an offensive around Tabarre against 400 Mawozo and Chen Mechan threats.

media.caption: Prime Minister Alix Didier Fils-Aimé speaks to reporters in Port-au-Prince

confidenceReason: Police announcement reported by Al Jazeera; death details from a police source.
